from pathlib import Path
import re
src=Path('Vero_Refine_KHeap_R.thy').read_text();b=re.search(r'\\(\\* VERO START c0127 prove \\*\\)(.*?)\\(\\* VERO END c0127 prove \\*\\)',src,re.S)[1]
pre=b[:b.index('  have abs:')].replace('ptr','t').replace('getEndpoint_def ','').replace('getEndpoint','getObject').replace('KOEndpoint','KOTCB').replace('loadObject_endpoint','loadObject_tcb')
con=b[b.index('  have con:'):b.index('  have rel:')].replace('ptr','t').replace(\"ep_at'\",\"tcb_at'\").replace('KOEndpoint','KOTCB')
tail=r'''  have abs: \"\\<And>s. is_etcb_at t s \\<Longrightarrow> \\<exists>ep. ekheap s t = Some ep\"
    by (auto simp: is_etcb_at_def)
  have rel: \"\\<And>s s' ep ep'. \\<lbrakk>(s,s') \\<in> state_relation; ekheap s t = Some ep; ksPSpace s' t = Some (KOTCB ep')\\<rbrakk> \\<Longrightarrow> etcb_relation ep ep'\"
  proof -
    fix s s' ep ep'
    assume sr: \"(s,s') \\<in> state_relation\" and kh: \"ekheap s t = Some ep\" and ch: \"ksPSpace s' t = Some (KOTCB ep')\"
    have er: \"ekheap_relation (ekheap s) (ksPSpace s')\" using sr by (simp add: state_relation_def)
    show \"etcb_relation ep ep'\" using er kh ch by (auto simp: ekheap_relation_def dom_def)
  qed
  have aget: \"\\<And>s ep. ekheap s t = Some ep \\<Longrightarrow> ethread_get f t s = ({(f ep,s)},False)\"
    by (simp add: ethread_get_def gets_the_def get_etcb_def gets_def get_def bind_def return_def assert_opt_def)
  have cget: \"\\<And>s ep. \\<lbrakk>ksPSpace s t = Some (KOTCB ep); is_aligned t (objBitsKO (KOTCB ep)); ps_clear t (objBitsKO (KOTCB ep)) s\\<rbrakk> \\<Longrightarrow> threadGet f' t s = ({(f' ep,s)},False)\"
    by (simp add: threadGet_def liftM_def bind_def get return_def)
  show ?thesis using abs con rel aget cget x by (fastforce simp: corres_underlying_def)
qed
'''
p=Path('Vero_Refine_TcbAcc_R.thy');s=p.read_text();s=re.sub(r'(\\(\\* VERO START c0189 prove \\*\\)).*?(\\(\\* VERO END c0189 prove \\*\\))',lambda m:m[1]+pre+con+tail+'\\n'+m[2],s,flags=re.S);p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 /backend/tool.py check Vero_Refine_TcbAcc_R"
